lines.en: I walk up the bamboo toward the top.
My tail is thicker than my body and sways.

lines.zh: 我四条腿踩过落叶，沙沙响。
lines.en: Four paws cross the fallen leaves with a rustle.
I make my way along a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我在竹竿之间钻来钻去。
lines.en: I weave between the bamboo stalks.
My front paw reaches out before I step.

lines.zh: 我从这块石头跳到那块。
lines.en: I hop from this rock to that one.

lines.zh: 我的爪垫踩在湿苔上打滑。
lines.en: My pads slip on the wet moss.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，在东张西望。
lines.en: I stop and start, looking all around.
The bamboo leaves close above me.
I lift a leg over a vine.
I trot down the slope.
My shadow sways on the leaves.
I sit on a branch and gnaw bamboo.
I wipe my face with a front paw.
My tail hangs down, swinging.

lines.zh: 我抬头听了一会儿鸟叫。
lines.en: I lift my head and listen to birds.
I curl myself into a ball.
The bamboo air is a little sweet.
I lick the sap off my paw.
I am watching a butterfly.
One ear turns, then settles.
I lean on the trunk and doze.
I hug the bamboo to my chest.

lines.zh: 有片叶子落在我鼻子上。
lines.en: A leaf lands on my nose.
I stretch and it feels good.
Do you have bamboo?
I look up at you, my neck tilted back.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩坏了一片叶子。
lines.en: Your boot crushed a leaf.
I am not afraid of you, but we are strangers.
Would you like to touch my tail?

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在动，听见你了。
lines.en: My ears are moving; I hear you.

lines.zh: 你坐得低一点，我就不躲。
lines.en: Sit lower and I will not hide.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，我先闻闻。
lines.en: Your hand comes near; let me sniff it first.

lines.zh: 我在竹子上，看得比你高。
lines.en: I am on the bamboo, higher than you.
Are you taking me home?
I know your scent now.
Your eyes curve when you smile.
Don't grab my tail; it sheds.
I settle by your feet; it is warm.
I tilt my head; I do not understand you.

lines.zh: 你把竹子举高，我就上去了。
lines.en: Hold the bamboo high and I will climb.
I dislike loud places.
The pain makes me shrink up the branch.

lines.zh: 这一下让我从树上掉了。
lines.en: That knocked me out of the tree.
I curl up holding my belly.
You hit far too hard.
I lick the wound and keep still.
I retreat deeper into the bamboo.
Stop; I cannot fight you.
Ouch... just hand me a bamboo shoot.
Bamboo! Give me bamboo!
I smell tender shoots.

lines.zh: 我坐起来，两只前爪伸着。
lines.en: I sit up with both paws reaching.
This stalk is too old; another one.
Once I hold bamboo, I do not let go.
Set it down; I will take it myself.
One bite and my eyes narrow happily.
One more; I can still eat.
This tastes sweeter than wild bamboo.
I eat while watching you, in case you steal it.
Where did you hide the bamboo?
I rub against your leg for more.
Feed me and I will go with you.
I gnaw quickly; don't rush me.
I will save this one for later.

lines.zh: 你手里还有吗，我闻到了。
lines.en: Is there more in your hand? I can smell it.
I roll over with it in my arms.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我毛都竖了。
lines.en: You bumped me and my fur stood up.
I am soft; I cannot hurt you.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我从竹子上滑下来。
lines.en: The bump slides me down the bamboo.
You pressed on my thick tail.
I step aside and shake my fur.
Your leg is three times thicker than mine.
I rub against you once.
We collide and leaves fall.
I hop onto the next bamboo stalk.
I am young; ask me later.
There are many of us in the bamboo.

lines.zh: 我只会啃竹子，不懂这个。
lines.en: I only know how to gnaw bamboo.

lines.zh: 先给我一根嫩竹，再谈这个。
lines.en: Bring me a tender bamboo shoot, then we'll talk.
I tilt my head and climb the tree.
My tail sways once as an answer.
I prefer being on my own.
That depends on the season.
I bury my face in my paws.
Ask me again with bamboo.
It is a little heavier than a bamboo leaf.
I sniff; there is no bamboo scent.
I hug it to my chest.

lines.zh: 掉了，我从竹子上滑下去。
lines.en: Dropped it; I slide down the bamboo.
I carry it in my teeth as I climb.
Could this be a pillow?
I will hide it in the hollow first.
I turn it over and over.
There; tucked into my cheek.
Something is moving in the bamboo.
I lift my head, ears forward.
I climb high first to look.
This smell is wrong.
I fix on that spot and freeze.
Something snapped a bamboo branch.
I tuck myself in, ready to run.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向看了一眼。
lines.en: I glance toward you.
I do not know whether to call out.
That shadow is a little smaller than a leopard.
I watch from up in the bamboo.
It circles left; I turn too.
My ears stay pointed that way.

lines.zh: 我尽量不出声，压着竹叶。
lines.en: I stay quiet, holding the leaves still.
If it comes, I go up.
My tail is stiff and straight.
I count its steps.
The leaves hide me from it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往更高的枝上挪。
lines.en: I ease onto a higher branch.
I swat its nose with a front paw.
I bite; my teeth are small.
That was only meant to scare it.
It lunges; I dodge behind a tree.
I whip my tail across its face.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，我趁机上树。
lines.en: It backs off and I climb.

lines.zh: 我的爪子留下三道浅口。
lines.en: My claws leave three shallow lines.
One more swipe, then I run.
It does not follow, and I relax.

lines.zh: 我从竹叶的响动里出现。
lines.en: I appear out of the rustle of bamboo.

lines.zh: 我落在一根竹枝上，晃了晃。
lines.en: I land on a branch and it sways.
The bamboo is thick here; good.
I look all around first.
The air is damp; I like it.
I lick my new paws.
My tail is not dry yet.
Monkeys are calling far off.
I descend the branch slowly.
There is not much fruit here.
Fire singes the fur of my tail.

lines.zh: 我从高枝摔下，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I fall from a high branch and lie dazed.
Water rushes up my nose and I thrash.
The blast rolls me down the slope.

lines.zh: 箭穿过竹林，扎进我后腿。
lines.en: An arrow comes through the bamboo and hits my hind leg.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我浑身发麻。
lines.en: That force leaves me numb all over.

lines.zh: 竹子都老了，我饿得没劲。
lines.en: The bamboo is all old; hunger saps me.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: The thunder is so loud my ears ring.
Nothing underfoot; my paws claw at air.
